paragraphs.text: Anyxni was one of Shanna 's crew on the Weatherlight prior to its Compleation .

Anyxni was a member of the Weatherlight 's cockpit crew, characterized by a resilient spirit that never seemed to wane, even in difficult situations. During the Phyrexian attack, Anyxni was gravely injured. When Shanna and Tiana later explored the corrupted Weatherlight, they discovered Anyxni's head fused into a Phyrexian tentacle. This grotesque transformation was a result of the ship's corruption. Shanna fought against these tentacles and eventually severed the one that contained Anyxni’s head, putting an end to Anyxni’s torment and freeing their spirit.
